hook.text: GPT generates human-like text by predicting one token at a time. It's Shannon's text generator scaled to billions.

buildup.text: LLMs learn probability distributions over language from trillions of tokens. They minimize cross-entropy loss.

discovery.text: Shannon's theory predicts: a perfect language model achieves entropy rate. LLMs approximate this remarkably well.

twist.text: These models don't understand meaning—they model statistical patterns. But the patterns are so rich they mimic insight.

climax.text: From Shannon's letter-by-letter generator to GPT: the same principle at incomprehensibly different scale.

punchline.text: Predict the next token. Repeat. That's the recipe.

quiz.question: What loss function do LLMs minimize during training?
